title: Nourishing Ethiopian Lentil Stew
description: This floral, gooey lentil stew combines aromatic berbere spice with creamy coconut milk and fresh ferns for a post‑workout Ethiopian delight.
instructions: Rinse the red lentils until the water runs clear.
Heat the clarified butter in a pot over medium heat and sauté the onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and tomato paste, cooking until fragrant.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Add the coconut milk and chopped ferns, stirring until the ferns wilt and the stew thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let the stew rest for five minutes before serving.
Serve hot over a bed of rice or with injera.
Enjoy the floral, gooey flavors in this nourishing post‑workout meal.
